sloka: गुहाः च विचिताः सर्वा याः च ते परिकीर्तिताः ।विचिताः च महागुल्मा लता वितत संतताः ॥४-४७-१२॥
transliteration: guhāḥ ca vicitāḥ sarvā yāḥ ca te parikīrtitāḥ ।vicitāḥ ca mahāgulmā latā vitata saṁtatāḥ ॥4-47-12॥

translations.english: 'We searched for her in the caves, in places filled with extensive vines and huge bushes and in all places mentioned by you.
